clouds: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent atmosphere texture atlas for a dark Gothic fantasy game scene. Create FOUR DIFFERENT painterly storm cloud banks in an evenly spaced 2 by 2 grid on genuinely transparent alpha. Each cell contains one isolated wide horizontal formation with broad charcoal-plum shadow masses and muted dusty violet-gray brushwork, subtle warm ash edge light. Distinct silhouettes: a long flat bank, a layered curling bank, a soft diagonal veil, a sprawling low billow. Loose atmospheric fantasy illustration, suggested detail, restrained shapes, no noisy microtexture or photorealistic volume rendering. Each formation fades gently into transparency at all edges, generously separated from other cells with empty transparent margins. Use a landscape canvas, each cloud formation roughly three times wider than tall. No background scene, no buildings, no characters, no sky rectangle, no checkerboard painted into the art, no text, no labels. These clouds will be composited at low opacity over an existing cloudy dusk scene.
mist: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent ground mist texture atlas for a dark Gothic fantasy courtyard. Create FOUR DISTINCT wispy horizontal ground mist formations arranged in a clean evenly spaced 2 by 2 grid on genuinely transparent alpha. Smoke gray and muted pale violet, subtle ash beige glints, very low density, translucent with visible empty gaps and softly feathered transparent edges. One long thin curling ribbon, one low broken veil with separated wisps, one layered drifting haze with delicate eddies, one trailing tapered smoke stream. Painterly fantasy atmosphere with broad deliberate brushwork and implied detail, no repetitive tiny swirls. Landscape canvas, each cell's mist much wider than tall, generous empty margins and separation, no clipping at edges. No scene, no ground, no buildings, no characters, no glowing runes, no fire, no painted checkerboard, no labels or text. Intended to sit gently over uneven charcoal stone and around the base of a spectral purple-veiled puppeteer.
